subject: POC implementation responsibilities + streaming ops playbook
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Li <anna.li@novacorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Aug 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: POC implementation responsibilities + streaming ops playbook

Anna — thanks again for the call earlier. Below is a concise post-call recap and a proposed division of ownership for the 6-week POC so we can kick off Monday. Please review and confirm or edit.

1) Business success criteria (we captured on the call):
- End-to-end latency for search suggestions <= 120ms p95 for 128-token prompts
- Retrieval+ranking accuracy: improvement of mean reciprocal rank (MRR) by >= 18% vs baseline
- Cost target: keep inference token cost under $0.0009/token on average for the trial workload

2) Technical acceptance tests (redwood + Novacorp):
- Streaming responses enabled for interactive flows and validated using the sample chat probe (see attached streaming-api-route-matrix.pdf)
- SDK integration: client must be able to open/maintain kv-cache-enabled streaming sessions from web app and server-side batch runner
- Tool-calling: 2 example tool manifests (search, order-lookup) exercised end-to-end

3) High-level timeline (target start: 2028-09-04):
- Week 0 (setup): API keys, VPC peering (if needed), and sandbox routes provisioned — owner: Novacorp DevOps/Procurement to approve
- Week 1: SDK integration + streaming smoke tests — owner: Novacorp (frontend lead) with Redwood support (Ben)
- Week 2–3: Acceptance test runs, load profile tuning, and quantization profile suggestions — owner: Redwood inference team (Marissa + Karthik)
- Week 4–5: Evaluation matrix runs against test prompts and regression checks — owners: joint
- Week 6: Final acceptance, handoff to production checklist, and license/ops paperwork — owner: Novacorp procurement + Redwood sales

4) Immediate next steps (actionable items for this week):
- Novacorp: confirm point-of-contact for DevOps and provide VPN/KMS contact by Thu (Anna)
- Redwood: deliver SDK integration checklist and streaming route matrix (Ben) by Fri
- Joint: schedule a 60-minute kickoff technical call for Mon 2028-09-04 (I suggested 10am PT)

Attachments: novacorp-poc-success-criteria-v1.xlsx (success criteria workbook), streaming-api-route-matrix.pdf

If that aligns, I will lock owners and send calendar invites. Thanks — excited to get this running.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 28 Aug 2028 17:42:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC implementation responsibilities + streaming ops playbook

Thanks Markus — solid summary, appreciate the clarity. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Timeline: We can start Week 0 actions this week if Redwood can provide a short checklist for our Sec/Network review. DevOps is looped in (devops@novacorp.com).
- Procurement: I'll route the PO and scope to procurement; they typically need a one-page SOW + estimated monthly spend (procurement@novacorp.com).
- POC contacts: Frontend lead is Carlos Mendez (carlos.m@novacorp.com) and SRE lead is Priya Das (priya.d@novacorp.com). Please add them to the kickoff invite.

We confirm success criteria in the workbook but want to slightly relax the cost target to $0.0011/token peak to account for burst traffic. Is that acceptable?

I will confirm VPN/KMS ownership by Thu. Kickoff Monday 9/4 at 10am PT works for our team.
